title: Split a small buy across consecutive epochs
teach: Raises are earned by two consecutive positive closes, and the rule does not care how large those closes were. Three small buys on three consecutive days are enough to walk the multiplier up — cheap, but working exactly as written.

actions.note: signal is now positive: m earns a raise

expect.notesYellow: 0.3 ETH of net inflow, spread over three closes, walked the multiplier up. The rule is a sign test, not a size test.
